recording: Previously consumed calibrated TUM-VI room1, adapted to a Meridian transfer package.
image_scope: This measurement uses an earlier local worker image before final hosted queue and cleanup refinements. It qualifies the measured child profile; final-release HTTP fault checks use the separate operational evidence.

memory_observation.interpretation: The cgroup peak reached the 1 GiB limit and includes filesystem cache and all processes in that cgroup; it is not a measurement of Python resident memory. The supervised import completed successfully.

limitations: The stopwatch covers supervised local package validation and preparation, not browser upload or durable hosted publication.
Output sizes count validated manifest files in scratch, excluding the original archive and hosted publication marker.
The original archive is read-only; the probe does not duplicate it into scratch.
The measured earlier image is not presented as a rerun of the final deployed release.
No new reserved recording is opened, no calibration is fitted, and no estimator or flight experiment is run.
